title: Singing the blues to feel better
summary: Wallace says she cries over her brother and Hocile, plans new blues, and says singing the blues eases her mind.

story.theme_name: Where jazz stands today: young players, rock, and the audience
story.community_name: What the blues is, and why every jazz player needs it

blocks.x: What were you thinking about?

I was thinking about (unintelligible) thinking about it right now (unintelligible) nobody but me, (unintelligible) lonesome (singing) my good man is gone, left me. I said, he left me here, here in this room alone. I was thinking about my ________ all night long.
(Laughter.)
And I would just lay in that bed and cry.
(Laughter.)
You feel that way now?
Oh, I (unintelligible) cry.
Yeah?

I bet I'm going to cry tonight. After hearing all these songs, I'm going to be thinking of my poor brother and Hocile. Yeah, I'm going to cry tonight (unintelligible) I'm going to ________ and cry. I'm going to go in there tonight and cry my eyes out.
Well, what about writing some new blues?
I might write some more blues. In
fact, I'm going to write some more blues.
Good.
I got some more (unintelligible) lonesome blues. (Unintelligible).
Well, does it make you feel better when you sing the blues when you feel lonely?
Yeah, I feel better (inaudible).
(Recording interruption.)
You were telling me you feel better when you sing the blues, you feel better after you sing them.

Uh-huh, yeah, because I express my mind. Uh-huh. I can tell (unintelligible). When me and my husband used to have a fuss, well, he used to (unintelligible). Well, I couldn't fuss with him, but I put the record on and the record be fussing, be fussing with him, say, "Let's talk it over before we say good-night, sweetheart." (Unintelligible), I say, "Well, I'll put this song about 'Let's Talk It Over.'" (Laughter.)
That's wonderful.
Yeah, uh-huh. See, ______.

Yeah, I do, I said it. But I --
You sang lines like 'Gettin me another man.'
(Unintelligible). I mean it right then.
Uh-huh, okay.
Yeah, but I say, "Where there ain't no loving, there ain't no getting along."
Yeah.
